definitions.explanation: A specific calendar date expressed as year, month, and day. Commonly used on official documents and forms where a full date must be written.

examples.japanese: {年月日|ねんがっぴ}を{記入|きにゅう}してください。
{生年月日|せいねんがっぴ}は1990{年|ねん}5{月|がつ}10{日|にち}です。
examples.english: My date of birth is May 10, 1990.

examples.japanese: {契約書|けいやくしょ}に{年月日|ねんがっぴ}と{署名|しょめい}を{忘|わす}れずに{書|か}いてください。
examples.english: Please don't forget to write the date and your signature on the contract.

notes:
A compound of {年|ねん} (year), {月|がつ} (month), and {日|ひ} (day). Very common on Japanese forms and official documents. In Japanese date format, the order is always year → month → day.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年月日|ねんがっぴ}を{記入|きにゅう}する: to fill in the date
- {生年月日|せいねんがっぴ}: date of birth
- {発行|はっこう}{年月日|ねんがっぴ}: date of issue
- {届出|とどけで}{年月日|ねんがっぴ}: date of notification

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese official documents traditionally use the Japanese era system ({和暦|われき}) for dates (e.g., {令和|れいわ}8{年|ねん}), though Western calendar dates ({西暦|せいれき}) are also widely accepted. The {生年月日|せいねんがっぴ} field appears on nearly every official form in Japan.

RELATED WORDS:
- {日付|ひづけ}: date — more general and conversational
- {日時|にちじ}: date and time
